fields.summary: TEST-001 — Safe dry-run fixture for bridge validation
fields.description:
## Goal
Validate the Jira-to-Hermes bridge using this dedicated test fixture.

## Scope
Bridge script and dispatched task shape.

## Out of Scope
Real Jira modifications, production deployments.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A dry-run does NOT create Hermes tasks
- A dry-run does NOT modify Jira issues
- Eligibility check passes for this fixture
- Bounded context includes all sections
- Idempotency key format matches jira:<ISSUE-KEY>

## Tests and Evidence
- Unit tests in test_bridge.py (60+ tests)
- Idempotency test proves duplicate suppression
- Integration boundary tests for both adapters
- This fixture is used in the dry-run E2E test

## Security
- Credentials loaded from environment only
- All log output redacts tokens, API keys, and passwords
- No credentials committed to repository

## Context
BrandOS control-plane: scripts/jira_hermes_bridge.py
